approvers: my bank, my tax adviser and lawyer, my family
reason: A free confidential meeting costs me nothing and the staff and name promises in writing are what I care about. But they have no earlier sellers, so I would be the first to trust them with my life's work, and my adviser and bank will want to vet them thoroughly first.
objection: What happens to my staff and my customers after I go, and can I trust a buyer who has never done this before to keep their word?
instead: Keep looking for a trade or management buyer, or list on nexxt-change or with a broker at around EUR 375,000.
would_change_my_mind: My own adviser and bank confirming their funds and directors check out, plus a reference from someone who has dealt with them, or longer staff and site guarantees.
